label: copy-phase input u (fed-back u at recall position >= 3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (98% of mass) on steps whose input is the fed-back token u, i.e. right after the model has output u, at recall_idx >= 3 (t mostly 11-13). It never fires in the original phase or on the delimiter, and never on u at recall_idx < 3. Precision is low: only ~10% of copy-phase u inputs at recall_idx >= 3 activate, so some hidden-state context gates it. Activation is stronger and more frequent for longer sequences (L = 8-9 hold 86% of mass) and when the next output is h (u->h: precision 0.74, 39% of mass) or u. Rare weak firing on input h (about 2% of mass). The top activations are u followed by h in the original sequence.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: u, h, -, b, t, p; least: 0, 3, 2, q) and the token being output (most: h, u, 0, e, b, i; least: z, -, o, a); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=12, recall_idx=3.
